[Em7]dancing across the water With his
[Dsus2]galleons and guns
[Am7add11]Looking for the new world And that
palace in the sun On the
[Em7]shore lay Montezuma With his
[Dsus2]coca leaves and pearls In his
[Am7add11]halls, he often wondered With the
secrets of the world And his
[Em7]subjects Gathered around him Like the
[Dsus2]leaves around a tree In their
[Am7add11]clothes of many colors For the
angry gods to see And the
[Em7]women all were beautiful And the
[Dsus2]men stood Straight and strong

others could go on
